annotations.title: Check a package or tool against known malware

description: Check an npm or PyPI package name, or an Agent Tested slug, against Agent Tested's list of known malicious look-alikes of MCP servers and agent tools (from GitHub-reviewed malware advisories and OSV MAL records) and against tools marked 'Dangerous: avoid'. Also returns published security advisories (OSV.dev / GitHub) that Agent Tested found for that package at the version listed in the MCP Registry or the version we tested, with severity and fixed_in versions (verdict known_advisories). For any other npm/PyPI package it also does a live OSV.dev lookup (live_advisories), so newly published advisories show up the same day; pass version to check the exact version you plan to install. Use it before installing an MCP server or agent package. Not being listed does not prove a package is safe.

version.description: Optional exact version you plan to install; the live OSV.dev lookup then reports only advisories affecting it
